quarterly_data.signal: Oracle's remaining performance obligations were $552.6 billion as of February 28, 2026 versus $130.2 billion a year earlier, primarily due to certain significant cloud contracts; approximately 12% is expected to be recognized over the next twelve months, 31% over months 13 to 36 and 35% over months 37 to 60. Capital expenditures were $39.2 billion in the first nine months of fiscal 2026 versus $12.1 billion a year earlier, primarily due to data center expansion, and unconditional purchase and certain other obligations, primarily related to data center power arrangements, were $11 billion as of February 28, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $552.6 billion (February 28, 2026) vs $130.2 billion; 12% next twelve months, 31% months 13 to 36, 35% months 37 to 60; nine-month capex $39.2 billion vs $12.1 billion; purchase obligations $11 billion (primarily data center power)
